title: Repair frontend build/runtime stability and restore role-based dashboards

requirements.summary: Fix frontend build-time and runtime crashes caused by missing/empty modules, missing exports, and unsafe access to optional values (especially optional ExternalBlob fields).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend` builds successfully with TypeScript with no missing-module or missing-export errors.
App loads to the Landing Page when logged out and does not crash when logged in/out.
Any UI that reads optional blob fields (e.g., company logo/banner, user profile picture) guards against absent values and does not throw at runtime.

Harden featured companies rendering to avoid unsafe calls on optional blob fields; ensure any use of ExternalBlob methods is guarded (e.g., only call getDirectURL() when the blob is present).
Ensure profile-picture rendering remains fully guarded against missing customization/profilePicture values and cannot throw during rapid login/logout cycles.

requirements.summary: Fix authenticated routing so the post-setup dashboard is selected by role (candidate/employer/admin with fallback).
acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in user has role `#candidate`, the Candidate Dashboard is shown after profile setup.
When a signed-in user has role `#employer`, the Employer Dashboard is shown after profile setup.
When the signed-in user is an admin, the Admin Dashboard is shown (or a clear fallback is used if admin status cannot be determined).

file_operations.description: Update the authenticated render branch to choose AdminDashboard (when admin detection says admin), otherwise choose CandidateDashboard vs EmployerDashboard based on the signed-in user profile role; keep the existing profile-setup gating behavior.
Verify the employer dashboard can render as the authenticated landing view without relying on missing/empty tab modules; adjust imports/usage if necessary so the dashboard mounts cleanly.
Verify the candidate dashboard can render as the authenticated landing view without relying on missing/empty tab modules; adjust imports/usage if necessary so the dashboard mounts cleanly.

Ensure the admin dashboard can render as the authenticated landing view when admin is detected; if admin status cannot be determined, ensure a clear non-crashing fallback path exists in the app-level routing.

requirements.summary: Align frontend query/mutation hooks and default flows with the generated backend interface so actor calls do not fail at runtime (profile fetch/save/customization, company pages list retrieval, and admin detection when referenced).
acceptanceCriteria: All frontend React Query hooks invoked by default app flows (Landing Page, Header, Profile Setup, dashboards) have corresponding backend actor methods and do not fail due to missing canister methods.
Logged-in flow can successfully fetch `getCallerUserProfile()` and complete profile setup/customization without trapping due to absent methods.

file_operations.description: Adjust the exported React Query hooks used by default flows to call only methods that exist in the generated backend interface: ensure getCallerUserProfile uses actor.getCallerUserProfile, profile setup uses actor.saveCallerUserProfile (not a missing/incorrect method), profile customization uses actor.setProfileCustomization, admin detection uses actor.isCallerAdmin, and LandingPage company pages uses actor.getCompanyPages. Also ensure any hooks referenced by UI (e.g., company branding hooks) either call a real backend method or are safe placeholders that will not crash when invoked.

Update usage of the profile-save hook so the first-time profile setup persists via the backend method expected by the generated interface (saveCallerUserProfile inputs), and the app transitions cleanly to the correct dashboard afterward.

Reconcile referenced company branding hooks with what the backend interface actually provides: keep reads based on getCompanyPages when possible, and ensure create/update/upload actions degrade gracefully (clear toast + disabled or no-op) rather than attempting missing backend capabilities. Ensure any ExternalBlob direct URL calls are guarded. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob capability (e.g., getDirectURL()) safely. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the company pages query hook used here is wired to an existing backend method (getCompanyPages) and that the UI correctly handles empty results and optional blobs without throwing.
